Despite the changes, the momentum remained firmly with the visitors. With 73% possession and a total command of the pitch, Manchester City cruised through the final minutes to claim a comprehensive victory.

The goal was briefly held in the balance during a tense VAR review, but the referee eventually pointed to the center spot, confirming the lead. These narrow escapes kept the scoreline at 2-0 heading into the interval, leaving the door slightly ajar for a potential comeback. Despite late pressure from Antoine Semenyo and creative sparks from Rayan Cherki , the Arsenal defense remained resolute. In front of a crowd of 58,056 , the final whistle confirmed a comprehensive and deserved victory for the Gunners, as they marched into the next round with a performance of genuine authority.
